metadata.question: Did New York experience an air temperature difference of at least 24 degrees Celcius between January 29 and February 5, 2019?

data.raw_code: The question is about air temperature difference in New York between two specific dates in 2019. I need to: 1. Get temperature data for both dates 2. Calculate the difference 3. Check if it's ≥24°C For temperature data, I can use: - ERA5 (ECMWF reanalysis) - provides hourly temperature data - MODIS LST (land surface temperature) - but this might not be air temperature - GLDAS (global land data assimilation system) ERA5 would be best for air temperature. I'll use the '2m_temperature' band from ERA5. I need to: - Define New York area (I'll use a point around NYC) - Get temperature for Jan 29, 2019 and Feb 5, 2019 - Calculate daily mean temperature for each day - Compute the difference - Check if |difference| ≥ 24°C For ERA5, I should get daily mean temperature by averaging over the day. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const nyPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-74.0060, 40.7128]); // New York City const date1 = '2019-01-29'; const date2 = '2019-02-05'; // 2. Data Acquisition - ERA5 for air temperature const era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5/DAILY'); const temp1 = era5.filterDate(date1, '2019-01-30') .filterBounds(nyPoint) .select('mean_2m_air_temperature'); const temp2 = era5.filterDate(date2, '2019-02-06') .filterBounds(nyPoint) .select('mean_2m_air_temperature'); // Check collection sizes const count1 = temp1.size().getInfo(); const count2 = temp2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 29 Images: ${count1}, Feb 5 Images: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get mean temperature images const img1 = temp1.first(); const img2 = temp2.first(); // 3. Processing - Check valid pixels const count1_pixels = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: nyPoint, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('mean_2m_air_temperature').getInfo(); const count2_pixels = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: nyPoint, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('mean_2m_air_temperature').getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 29 Valid Pixels: ${count1_pixels}, Feb 5 Valid Pixels: ${count2_pixels}`); if (count1_pixels === 0 || count2_pixels === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get temperatures (convert from Kelvin to Celsius) const temp1_val = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: nyPoint, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('mean_2m_air_temperature').getInfo() - 273.15; // K to C const temp2_val = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: nyPoint, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('mean_2m_air_temperature').getInfo() - 273.15; // K to C const diff = Math.abs(temp2_val - temp1_val); console.log(`Jan 29 Temp: ${temp1_val.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Feb 5 Temp: ${temp2_val.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Difference: ${diff.toFixed(2)}°C`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (temp1_val === null || temp2_val === null || isNaN(temp1_val) || isNaN(temp2_val)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (diff >= 24) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
